mathematics.assertion_tested: Pool every original CT voxel into an explicitly labelled 144um artistic intensity cache, preserve every binary native 18um voxel in lossless bit slabs, and fit conditional patch-intensity mixture PPCA with spatial holdout and bounded display changes.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact UInt64 mask counts and weighted sums; Float64 mixture PPCA and Float32/U8 display arrays.
mathematics.conventions: Scanner-index XYZ in mm; array order ZYX; original mask and geometry never replaced.
inputs: All original 18um selected-mask and signed16 CT crop voxels
non_claims: No new acquired resolution or certified 1um accuracy
No biological interpretation of low-density candidates
Display residual reduction is not a ground-truth reconstruction error
